name: NFOGM (Norwegian Society for Oil and Gas Measurement)
notes: Norwegian upstream oil & gas metering society: initiator of the North Sea/Global Flow Measurement Workshop, co-host of the Hydrocarbon Management Workshop, metering handbooks, uncertainty-calculation programs and newsletters (1997-). Named in UPS measurement gaps. Access varies by publication. Evidence: nfogm.no read 2026-10-29.
